2d_in_3d_point_vis.name: 2d_in_3d_point_vis
2d_in_3d_point_vis.qfep_connection: a 2D point diagram raised into the room — the flat lesson made walkable; reference furniture for the eye.

2d_in_3d_vectors_vis.name: 2d_in_3d_vectors_vis
2d_in_3d_vectors_vis.qfep_connection: A flat lesson about direction is itself given a position and an orientation — the XR viewport renders the 2D vector board to a texture and hangs it as a body in S. To read about vectors you must first solve one: stand somewhere, face the plane.

AudioContr.name: AudioContr
AudioContr.qfep_connection: the audio controller — the room's mixing desk; infrastructure that routes the chapter's voices, never dominant itself.

ConnectedTriangles.name: ConnectedTriangles
ConnectedTriangles.qfep_connection: Before the three triangles can join, the manager reparents every corner sphere to itself and resets each triangle to the identity transform — connection is bought by surrendering your own coordinate frame. Gravity only switches on after three links: weight is the reward for federation.

HandheldInfoBoard.name: HandheldInfoBoard
HandheldInfoBoard.qfep_connection: A 2D page pushed through a viewport onto a quad, then framed, glassed, and issued a clearance zone that keeps bodies at reading distance — text made into furniture that negotiates space for its own legibility.

VRBrush.name: VRBrush
VRBrush.qfep_connection: The brush raycasts into the mesh, splits any edge longer than 0.6 and smooths what it finds, so resolution accrues exactly where the hand lingers. Attention is spent as vertices; the untouched surface stays coarse.

additive_wave_demo.description: Interactive demonstration of additive wave synthesis — layer sine waves of different frequencies and amplitudes to build complex waveforms. Visualizes Fourier's fundamental insight that any shape can be constructed from simple oscillations.
additive_wave_demo.name: Additive Wave Demo

agent_spawner.description: Spawns a walking cube-based agent character built from agent_data.json. Use agent_spawner#direction:1,0,0 to set walk direction.
agent_spawner.name: Cube Agent Spawner
agent_spawner.qfep_connection: A walking figure assembled from cubes according to agent_data.json, handed a direction vector and set going — the body arrives as a file, the gait as a parameter. Character reduced to its config, which is precisely what makes it swappable.

agnes_grid.description: Agnes grid system for spatial arrangement and interaction
agnes_grid.name: Agnes Grid
agnes_grid.qfep_connection: Martin's hand-ruled grid, redrawn in code and piped through a SubViewport onto a grabbable slab — a painting demoted to a texture so it can be picked up and turned. What survives the pipeline is the grid; what doesn't is the tremor that made her lines worth standing near.

agnes_grid_2d.name: Agnes Grid 2D
agnes_grid_2d.qfep_connection: One _draw() call: cream ground, grey lines at 0.3 alpha, ten by ten, never touched again. F_order at its most naked — a grid before anything is asked of it, with subtlety encoded as a literal transparency value.

attention_economy_sim.description: Multiple competing content streams fight for a single attention bar.
attention_economy_sim.name: Attention Economy Sim
attention_economy_sim.qfep_connection: A market in which one side is finite and the other is not does not converge on equilibrium — it converges on a permanent scream. The artifact clears perfectly every tick and satisfies a smaller fraction of what was asked each time, which is the shape of an attention economy stated as arithmetic rather than as complaint.

backpropagation_flow.description: Gradient flowing backward through network layers.
backpropagation_flow.name: Backpropagation Flow
backpropagation_flow.qfep_connection: Backpropagation is not a signal travelling backward, it is credit being divided: each layer takes the blame handed to it, multiplies by a derivative smaller than one, and passes on the remainder. The dimming toward the input is not a stylistic fade -- it is the arithmetic of that division, which is why depth was a thirty-year problem and why the choice of derivative was the thing that broke it open.

ball_painting_demo.name: ball_painting_demo
ball_painting_demo.qfep_connection: The brush is a grabbable ball whose tip is a raycast, its hits quantized to a snap grid on the paper: the canvas records not intention but wherever the held sphere's ray happened to land, mark-making pushed one joint away from the hand.

barnsley_fern.description: Classic Barnsley fern rendered via iterated function system — four affine transforms with weighted probabilities produce the iconic fractal fern shape as a point cloud on a floor display. Density-based coloring reveals the self-similar structure.
barnsley_fern.name: Barnsley Fern

bias_visualizer.description: Interactive visualization of statistical and algorithmic bias — demonstrates how initial conditions, training data, or parameter choices create systematic skew in outputs. A critical theory artifact making invisible biases tangible.
bias_visualizer.name: Bias Visualizer
bias_visualizer.qfep_connection: Bias is frozen E(S) â€” entropy collapsed into stereotypes. The model minimizes prediction error (F) by encoding societal patterns. Critical Ï†: questioning whose data, whose categories.

big_o_race.description: Algorithms race visually on parallel tracks.
big_o_race.name: Big O Race

bridget_riley_op_art.name: Bridget Riley Op Art
bridget_riley_op_art.qfep_connection: The illusion is entirely fragment-side — nothing in this object moves, no _process runs, and a still capture carries the shimmer exactly as VR does, which is the argument: the motion was never in the painting. Raising g_wobble buys that motion by spending the flat reading, so the critical parameter is literally the price at which perception stops reporting and starts constructing.

ca_rule_explorer.description: Browse and experiment with different cellular automata rule sets in real-time. Dial through Wolfram's elementary rules or configure custom neighborhood and transition tables to discover the full spectrum from dead stillness to chaotic noise, with complexity emerging at the edge.
ca_rule_explorer.name: Cellular Automata Rule Explorer
ca_rule_explorer.qfep_connection: Rule 110 is Turing complete â€” proof that simple local rules can produce universal computation. Edge of chaos territory.

cache_hit_visualizer.description: Memory hierarchy visualization: L1, L2, L3 cache and RAM.
cache_hit_visualizer.name: Cache Hit Visualizer

camera_context.description: Camera system for viewing and perspective control
camera_context.name: Camera Context
camera_context.registry_note: RETIRED 2026-07-29 (build-or-retire triage): Scene-composition helper (a bare Node3D named Camera) swept into the artifact registry; never an artifact.

cctv.description: Security camera monitor. Use cctv:rotation:ytrans:scale to configure.
cctv.name: CCTV Monitor
cctv.qfep_connection: The monitor never watches the world — it instances a private copy of the target scene inside its own SubViewport and films that. Surveillance staged honestly: the feed is always a model of the room, never the room.

centripetal_force_demo.description: Ball on a string in circular motion. Cut the string to see tangential escape.
centripetal_force_demo.name: Centripetal Force Demo

circular_buffer.description: Ring buffer visualization. Elements enter from one end and wrap around.
circular_buffer.name: Circular Buffer
circular_buffer.qfep_connection: Circular indexing turns linear arrays into loops.

clipboard.capacity: NAVIGATE paged tutorial content as a stateful object in the world.
clipboard.description: A world-space document you have to hold in order to read. Pages, code snippets, and tutorial fragments stay coherent while the object flips between states, positions, and content sets. Because it is grabbable, reading becomes an embodied interaction rather than a detached overlay. It is the sequence's stable carrier for changing information.
interactions: grab the clipboard to reveal it as a held document
flip pages with VR trigger or grip input
swap content via apply_grid_config page keys or tutorial IDs
drop the clipboard to finish the reading interaction
clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.qfep_connection: Transformation changes the clipboard's state, page, and content while preserving a continuous reading object. It is S as interface transition rather than geometric motion.

clipboard_large.name: clipboard_large
clipboard_large.qfep_connection: The vectors lesson — 'Axiom 1: a point is a vector' — typeset on a viewport page at clipboard scale, while the title above it still reads keyboard-mash. A lecture on the invisible point, carried as office equipment, caught half-dressed.

code.name: code
code.qfep_connection: An A4 control whose text block is the .tscn source of an A4 control — the page displays its own serialization. Reading it is reading how everything else in this world is stored; the scene format caught describing itself.

code_display.description: Display system for showing code and text content
code_display.name: Code Display
code_display.qfep_connection: a code and text pane — the room's marginal note; it shows the notation beside the demonstration, never dominant, a container for whatever the lesson is currently saying.

dna.default: support=none - the shipped code path, so existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: a screen with no declared way of meeting the floor: support was hard-coded to nothing, so every placement floated or relied on the map to improvise a mount
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 — the axis was already in the script and the registry had never been told, so the sweep could not reach it

constraint_sculptor.name: Constraint Sculptor
constraint_sculptor.qfep_connection: lambda_edge: sculpting inside randomized constraints — the material answers with bounded surprise; authorship shared with chance.

control_pendulum.description: A pendulum with configurable control parameters — adjust damping, driving force, and frequency to explore the transition from periodic motion through quasi-periodicity to chaos. The canonical example of nonlinear dynamics in a physical system.
control_pendulum.name: Control Pendulum

coupled_pendulums.description: Two or more pendulums connected by springs or shared supports, demonstrating energy transfer, normal modes, and synchronization. Watch energy slosh back and forth between pendulums — the physical basis of beat frequencies and resonance coupling.
coupled_pendulums.name: Coupled Pendulums
coupled_pendulums.qfep_connection: Energy oscillates between subsystems. Î» = coupling strength. At edge of chaos, unpredictable transfer patterns emerge.

crystal_ball.description: Interactive crystal ball for mystical interactions and predictions
crystal_ball.name: Crystal Ball
crystal_ball.qfep_connection: Prophecy is replaced by a boolean: contact flips is_touched in the shader, a 3.5-second timer flips it back. The cooldown's refusal to respond again immediately is what turns a switch into a ritual — the glow feels granted, not toggled.

cube_create.description: Tool for creating and manipulating cubes in 3D space
cube_create.name: Cube Creator
cube_create.qfep_connection: Registered as a cube tool, it actually runs the genesis sequence — triangle, plane, pyramid, cube, on to sphere and fish — each hand-built from vertex arrays under a wireframe shader. The claim is ontological: every solid here is triangles that stopped apologizing for it.

data_labor_counter.description: Visualizes hidden human labor behind AI systems.
data_labor_counter.name: Data Labor Counter
data_labor_counter.qfep_connection: Both numbers on the panel are true and they are the same number divided differently — which is exactly how a labour cost becomes a throughput figure. The tally wall is the division made physical: it grows until you have to look past the labour to read the output, and it is never cleared, only allowed to overflow.

dimensional_analogy.description: Step-by-step: point to line to square to cube to tesseract.
dimensional_analogy.name: Dimensional Analogy
dimensional_analogy.qfep_connection: The fourth dimension arrives here as a verb, not a place: four times the room watches a figure dragged along an axis it did not have, and the fifth time the same gesture simply runs past where a body can stand. What the projection hides is that the tesseract is not stranger than the cube -- only further from the floor.

disco_floor.description: A shimmering grid that pulses with disco energy
disco_floor.name: Disco Grid
disco_floor.qfep_connection: Rather than bring its own stage, it hunts the map's GridMultiMesh through the parent hierarchy and plays its array lessons on the floor already under your feet — corner, row, column, snake, spiral. Indexing taught by possession: the level geometry becomes the array being indexed.

distribution_sampler.description: Sample from various probability distributions — uniform, Gaussian, Poisson, exponential — and watch the histogram build in real-time. Compare theoretical curves with empirical results, experiencing the law of large numbers as shapes converge.
distribution_sampler.name: Distribution Sampler
distribution_sampler.qfep_connection: Distributions as 'shape of randomness' â€” entropy has structure. Different distributions = different Î» signatures.

dna_specimen.description: A detailed 3D model of a DNA double helix displayed as a museum specimen. The iconic twisted ladder of nucleotide base pairs — adenine-thymine, guanine-cytosine — rendered as a structural biology exhibit. Information encoded in molecular geometry.
dna_specimen.name: DNA Specimen

drag_coefficient_wind_tunnel.description: Virtual wind tunnel with swappable shapes. Particle streamlines show flow.
drag_coefficient_wind_tunnel.name: Drag Coefficient Wind Tunnel
drag_coefficient_wind_tunnel.qfep_connection: Drag is the environment pushing back.

draw_calls_display.name: draw_calls_display
draw_calls_display.qfep_connection: Seven lines of code make the renderer confess its labor: one label polling RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS every frame. The cost of appearing becomes an object you can stand beside — spectacle metering itself from inside the spectacle.

drawing_paper.description: Paper surface for drawing and artistic creation
drawing_paper.name: Drawing Paper
drawing_paper.qfep_connection: A pickable pen whose tip raycasts into a GPU canvas; with wet paint enabled, a simulation pass keeps the ink flowing after the hand has left. The mark outlives the gesture and goes on negotiating — drawing as a deposit into a surface with its own weather.

drawing_pen.description: Pen tool for drawing on surfaces
drawing_pen.name: Drawing Pen
drawing_pen.qfep_connection: The pen holds no code — body and tip are bare meshes; the paper's raycast-and-texture surface does all the sensing and keeps every mark. Authorship migrates to the substrate, and the tool becomes an excuse to approach it.

durer_scene.description: DÃ¼rer's Melencolia I elements: truncated rhombohedron polyhedron, magic square, compass, ladder, hourglass, bell, scales.
durer_scene.name: DÃ¼rer Melencolia Scene
durer_scene.qfep_connection: The furniture of Melencolia I gathered — the truncated rhombohedron, the magic square, the compass, the ladder. Dürer's engraving of geometry's melancholy, staged as objects: the chapter's close made walkable, thought's tools lying idle around a mind that has run out of certainty.

filter_bubble_demo.description: Recommendation engine that narrows content over time.
filter_bubble_demo.name: Filter Bubble Demo
filter_bubble_demo.qfep_connection: The engine never deletes anything; it only stops sampling — and stopping sampling is indistinguishable from deletion unless something keeps drawing what was dropped. The ghost spiral is the artifact and the shrinking arc is only the evidence: nineteen rounds of personalisation left visible as nineteen foreclosures with timestamps, against a horizon ring the recommender cannot touch.

flow_field_painter.description: Paint with vector fields — particles follow the flow you create, tracing streamlines that reveal the hidden topology of your brushstrokes. Combines art and physics as your gestures define the force landscape that particles navigate.
flow_field_painter.name: Flow Field Painter
flow_field_painter.qfep_connection: Noise as structured randomness â€” not chaos, not order, but Î»-edge. Flow reveals hidden structure.

fluid_taxonomy_tree.description: A taxonomy that morphs. Categories branch, merge, dissolve.
fluid_taxonomy_tree.name: Fluid Taxonomy Tree
fluid_taxonomy_tree.qfep_connection: Each branch has no colour of its own — it shows the mean hue of whoever is currently inside it, so a category's identity visibly drifts every time a leaf walks across the ring or two branches fuse. The displaced counter climbs to 12 of 12 and stays there: a taxonomy is not a picture of relationships, it is a record of the last time someone decided.

force_field_visualizer.description: Visualize gravitational, electric, and magnetic force fields in 3D using arrow glyphs and particle tracers. Place sources and sinks to sculpt the field landscape, then release test particles to see how forces guide motion through space.
force_field_visualizer.name: Force Field Visualizer
force_field_visualizer.qfep_connection: Fields as invisible structure â€” order you can't see until you probe it. The hidden F that shapes everything.

found_object_assembler.description: Grab scene fragments from a junk pile and compose freely.
found_object_assembler.name: Found Object Assembler
found_object_assembler.qfep_connection: The heap and the table hold the same objects; only one of them has a grid, and that is the entire difference between debris and a component. Bricolage is not the act of recombining found parts — it is the moment somebody decides where the cells start, after which the junk has somewhere it is supposed to be.

fractal_space.name: fractal_space
fractal_space.qfep_connection: Seeded diamond-square to depth five: each subdivision halves the step and scales displacement by a roughness constant, then the result is meshed and given collision. Scale-invariance becomes floor — you sample the recursion with your ankles, at exactly one height per footfall.

frame_counter_display.description: label.text = Engine.get_process_frames() — a live counter of rendered frames since startup
frame_counter_display.name: frame_counter_display
frame_counter_display.qfep_connection: Engine.get_process_frames() shown live — the render loop counting itself out loud. The most honest artifact in the room: a reminder that all this geometry is being redrawn dozens of times a second, that the still point and the solid cube are both, underneath, a number ticking up.

dna.default: reading=count, epoch=boot - the legacy three-line behaviour to the character, so all 11 existing placements are untouched
dna.was: three lines and zero exports: label.text = "%d" % Engine.get_process_frames(). The hard-coded parameter space was hiding in that one format string - a cumulative count is the least honest thing a frame counter can say, and the artifact's own truth line ('there is no continuous time in real-time 3D, only discrete frame steps') asks for the rate readout its @identity had been requesting since it was written
dna.note: declaration completed by hand - the promoting agent wrote the script and died on the session limit before declaring the axes

frames_display.name: frames_display
frames_display.qfep_connection: A Label3D printing frames-per-second inside the very frames it counts. The render loop's E_flux budget — normally invisible overhead — stands in the world as an object taxed by its own reading.

game_of_life_petri.description: Conway's Game of Life presented as a laboratory petri dish — cellular automata as biological experiment. Watch gliders, oscillators, and still lifes emerge from simple birth/death rules in a circular containment vessel.
game_of_life_petri.name: Game of Life Petri Dish
game_of_life_petri.qfep_connection: Game of Life operates at the edge of chaos â€” simple enough to be deterministic, complex enough to be unpredictable. Turing complete computation from four rules.

game_time_display.name: game_time_display
game_time_display.qfep_connection: Nothing but the engine's own uptime, formatted HH:MM:SS on a floating label: not world time, not story time, but how long the machine has been holding this world up — duration as infrastructure confession.

garbage_collector_demo.name: Garbage Collector Demo
garbage_collector_demo.qfep_connection: The collector never asks whether an object still works, only whether anyone can still reach it. Watching a dense, self-consistent island of cells go grey because one reference was dropped is watching unreachability do the condemning that uselessness gets blamed for.

glitch_body.description: Mesh that refuses stable form — a procedural sphere-like shape rebuilt every frame with time-varying noise perturbation and HSV hue cycling. Vertices oscillate, stretch, and collapse; the mesh is always transforming, never settling. A body in continuous becoming, resisting fixed categorization.
glitch_body.name: Glitch Body

grabable_agnes.name: Grabable Agnes
grabable_agnes.qfep_connection: An Agnes Martin grid — grey lines at 0.3 alpha on cream — bolted to a rigid body you can pick up and drop. The quietest painting in modernism is given mass and a collision shape; contemplation becomes subject to gravity.

grabable_mondrian.description: Interactive Mondrian composition that can be picked up, manipulated, and examined in VR space
grabable_mondrian.name: Grabable Mondrian
grabable_mondrian.qfep_connection: Neoplastic equilibrium regenerated on a ten-second timer, then mounted on a grabbable rigid body. Composition was supposed to be final; here it is a sample from a distribution that you can hold while it changes its mind.

graphics_monitor.description: 3D monitor with frame displaying visualization graphics. Use #vectors, #forces, #arrays, #waves, #randomness, or #procedural
graphics_monitor.name: Graphics Monitor
graphics_monitor.qfep_connection: A television for mathematics: the same frame accepts #vectors, #waves, or #polyhedra and simply changes channel. Explanation here is furniture — placed on the grid like a chair.

graphics_slideshow.description: Non-interactive visualization display that cycles through frames every 5 seconds. Use #topic:vectors, forces, arrays, waves, randomness, or procedural
graphics_slideshow.name: Graphics Slideshow
graphics_slideshow.qfep_connection: A textbook that turns its own pages: five seconds per frame, a SubViewport rendered to a sprite, no input accepted. The lesson advances whether or not you were looking — pedagogy's oldest politics, put on a timer.

graphics_slideshow_2d.description: 2D fullscreen slideshow - navigate with A/D, Left/Right, or Space. Press ESC to close
graphics_slideshow_2d.name: Graphics Slideshow 2D
graphics_slideshow_2d.qfep_connection: The same teaching boards flattened to fullscreen and put under keyboard command, A and D instead of walking. What VR stages as encounter, the 2D fallback admits is a deck of slides — same sequence, body discarded.

graphics_slideshow_all.description: Navigate through all graphics boards - use keyboard (A/D or Left/Right arrows) to flip through topics
graphics_slideshow_all.name: Graphics Slideshow All
graphics_slideshow_all.qfep_connection: Fourteen boards behind one screen, vectors through coordinate system, advanced by keypress; a map can pin the start_topic through grid config. The whole curriculum collapses to one index variable incremented mod fourteen — which is what a curriculum is, once you strip the walking.

grid_eye.description: Grid point visualization for spatial awareness
grid_eye.name: Grid Eye
grid_eye.qfep_connection: Every frame it rounds your position to integers, paints your cell red on a 24-by-24 texture, and asks aloud: in what way are we becoming a point on a grid? The answer is already executing in _process — quantization here is not a metaphor but a surveillance being applied to you.

hand_color_controller.description: Uses a 3D value mapper to live-adjust VR hand nail materials with a preview cube.
hand_color_controller.name: hand_color_controller
hand_color_controller.qfep_connection: relation: the nails' sibling mapper — the same live adjustment addressed to the whole hand; identity's palette widened one joint at a time.

hand_model.description: Static hand-model reference for VR scale and positioning — provides a human-proportioned anchor for sizing artifacts in the scene.
hand_model.name: hand_model
hand_model.qfep_connection: a human-proportioned reference hand — the room's quiet ruler; it marks the inhabited scale without asserting content.

harmonic_motion_demo.description: Interactive simple harmonic motion demonstration — a mass oscillating on a spring with real-time graphs of position, velocity, and acceleration. Adjust spring constant and mass to see how frequency depends on physical parameters.
harmonic_motion_demo.name: Harmonic Motion Demo

health_display.description: Live health readout panel wired to GameManager.health_updated — shows current hit points on a Label3D and updates every frame the value changes.
health_display.name: health_display
health_display.qfep_connection: a live health readout wired to the game state — instrument panel, always present but never the lesson; it marks the inhabited stakes.

helper_arm.description: Mechanical helper arm for assistance and manipulation
helper_arm.name: Helper Arm
helper_arm.qfep_connection: Rigid links strung on hinge joints, a grabbable Klein bottle for a hand: pull the end and the whole chain answers through its constraints. Assistance is staged honestly — the arm can only help along the degrees of freedom its hinges concede.

hits_reset_display.description: Counter panel showing hits taken toward map reset — displays N / max, incrementing as the player accumulates damage from hazards.
hits_reset_display.name: hits_reset_display
hits_reset_display.qfep_connection: the damage counter toward map reset — instrument panel, always present but never the lesson; consequence made legible.

hypercube_rotation.description: 4D tesseract projected to 3D with rotation controls.
hypercube_rotation.name: Hypercube Rotation
hypercube_rotation.registry_note: RETIRED 2026-07-29 (build-or-retire triage): Registered scene is an empty stub; the working 4D machinery lives in tesseract_bench.

impulse_collision_demo.description: Two masses on a rail collide. Adjustable mass ratio and initial velocities.
impulse_collision_demo.name: Impulse Collision Demo

index_map_puzzle.description: Puzzle where you remap array indices to achieve target patterns.
index_map_puzzle.name: Index Map Puzzle
index_map_puzzle.qfep_connection: Index remapping is a discrete transformation.

info_display.name: info_display
info_display.qfep_connection: A scrollable text panel that disciplines the hand before it delivers the text: enter its pose area and your fingers are forced into pointing. Reading is given a prescribed gesture — the interface decides what a hand is for.

infokiosk.description: Freestanding kiosk combining a 2D-in-3D message console with a vertical status monitor for lab readouts.
infokiosk.name: infokiosk
infokiosk.qfep_connection: A message console and a vertical status monitor bolted into one freestanding cabinet: the lab's logging given a body you can walk up to. GameManager's console stream — normally developer exhaust — becomes furniture, the system narrating itself in public.

interactable_demo.description: Inspection rig laying out one of every VR control type in a single row — buttons, knobs, sliders (smooth/horizontal/snap/zero), lever, and wheel — each labelled for testing and review.
interactable_demo.name: interactable_demo
interactable_demo.qfep_connection: One of every VR control laid out in a row — buttons, knobs, sliders, dials — the inspection rig for how a hand touches this world. Not a wave but the *interface* to waves: the chapter's honest admission that oscillation is only teachable if you can grab a parameter and turn it, and here is every way this project lets you turn one.

jelly_variants.description: A collection of soft body jelly cubes with different material properties — varying stiffness, damping, and viscosity. Poke, squeeze, and throw them to feel how parameters shape deformation behavior. A tactile physics playground.
jelly_variants.name: Jelly Cube Variants
jelly_variants.qfep_connection: Parameter space exploration â€” stiffness, pressure, damping create different morphological behaviors

julia_set_explorer.description: Navigate the infinite complexity of Julia sets — zoom into fractal boundaries where order and chaos interweave at every scale. Adjust the complex parameter c to morph between connected and disconnected Julia sets, watching the Mandelbrot set's DNA unfold.
julia_set_explorer.name: Julia Set Explorer
julia_set_explorer.qfep_connection: Julia sets from c inside Mandelbrot are connected (ordered). Outside = disconnected dust (chaos). The c parameter IS a Î»-like dial.

kitbash_station.description: Combine random artifact fragments into new forms.
kitbash_station.name: Kitbash Station

latent_space_walk.description: Walk through a VAE/GAN latent space.
latent_space_walk.name: Latent Space Walk
latent_space_walk.qfep_connection: A latent space has no gaps: the four corners are the only points anything was ever learned at, and every form between them decodes to something nobody trained on. The model is mostly made of what it was never shown, and here that middle is floor you can stand on.

adjacency_shelf.description: A two-tone laminate wedge shelf holding three stock props. The shelf answers to its own contents: a coherent triptych fuses the laminate into one surface, an incoherent one splits it and runs a seam down the wedge. Display furniture is never neutral. Config: #slot_a:fire_extinguisher#coherence:0.85
adjacency_shelf.name: Adjacency Shelf

poor_image_gate.description: A doorway with a different bargain on each side: high resolution behind a gilt frame and a rope, or a coarse quantised sample you can walk straight out of. The degradation is real geometry at a lower sample rate, not a blur over a fine mesh. Config: #side:rich#poor_samples:4
poor_image_gate.name: Poor Image Gate

dna.retired_axis: rich_samples - measured INERT (focus 1.9%): 14 and 26 subdivisions both read as fine, so the knob varied nothing. The argument of this artifact lives on the POOR side; declaring an axis that does not move is how a sweep comes to look like evidence.

unfinishable_terrarium.description: A sealed vivarium on a steel stand with a brass hour meter bolted to the frame. State persists to user:// across sessions and the meter reads the wall clock; growth is a function of hours and hours only increase. No reset control exists anywhere in the artifact or its config, which is the piece. Config: #preview_hours:120
unfinishable_terrarium.name: Unfinishable Terrarium

dna.note: preview_hours is for capture only. It previews a later reading; it does not reset anything, because nothing here resets.

multiple_ring.description: A ring of one ordinary prop, cast in a single matte colour and repeated. Removing a member never leaves a gap: the survivors redistribute to a fresh even spacing, so no position ever belonged to anyone. Config: #subject:fire_extinguisher#count:14#removed:0
multiple_ring.name: Multiple Ring

default_body_bay.description: A chroma-key bay with a figure in the engine's own default state. Each click of the dial accepts one unmarked convention (skin tone, proportion, rig, idle, finish), stencils its provenance on the wall, and retires a fifth of the blue. The bay is honest at 0 and looks finished at 5. Config: #defaults_applied:0
default_body_bay.name: Default Body Bay

dna.default: defaults_applied=0 - fully chroma, nothing decided yet

operational_eye.description: A service rack of machine views - A* cost field, the player as a capsule and velocity vector, camera frustum, collision hulls, the capture rig's AABB, the LOD ramp. Flat false colour, no composition: operational images, made to run the world rather than to be looked at. Config: #channel:1#cols:3
operational_eye.name: Operational Eye

dna.default: channel=1 - the subject view foregrounded: you, as the system holds you

stock_stratum.description: A core sample under glass whose strata are the project's own most-placed props, live-instanced and frozen in the seam. Bed thickness is proportional to placement count, thickest at the base, so the core reads bottom-up: what gets placed most is the ground everything else stands on. Reads commons/data/placement_census.json. Config: #max_bands:6#reveal:0.74#live_props:true
stock_stratum.name: Stock Stratum

dna.note: A readymade: nothing in the strata is modelled for the piece. The surrealism is compression, not invention.

sturtevant_bench.description: An artifact beside the same artifact rebuilt from its own @identity prose, on two identical plinths. A deterministic copyist reads the claim, knows twelve shapes and cannot see the source; where the words named nothing buildable the twin comes out smooth and confident. The readout counts both sides. Config: #subject:galton_board#subject_scale:0.42
sturtevant_bench.name: Sturtevant Bench

dna.note: The enforcement arm of the @identity convention: 817 artifacts carry a claim, and this puts one of them next to what its claim actually builds.

lineage_vitrine.description: An object shown beside the siblings it did not become. Reads a subject artifact's declared dna.axes from the registry, instantiates one sibling per value along a rail, and keeps exactly ONE of them solid while the rest stand as ghosts. Stepping the axis moves which sibling is real; nothing else changes. Config: #subject:request_note#axis:mode#axis_index:0
lineage_vitrine.name: Lineage Vitrine

dna.default: subject=request_note, axis=mode - the first artifact promoted in stage 2
dna.note: The first artifact whose subject is the DNA system itself. Displays a family and lets the realised member move within it.

library_rack.description: Universal collection display wall. Reads any artifact registry and builds a grid of cubes, each containing a scaled-down artifact or shader. Config: #collection:shaders#cols:6#rows:4
library_rack.name: Library Rack

line_interface.description: Interactive line tool packaged for interface use with grab spheres and dynamic length display.
line_interface.name: line_interface
line_interface.qfep_connection: Two grab spheres and the segment between them, length read out live — but drag it near a whole number and it jitters, buzzes, and resists letting go. Integers are staged as privilege: the continuum pays a haptic toll at every round value.

dna.default: readout=numeral - the shipped code path, so existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: the artifact's critical_parameter was a RATE - 'the glitch/haptic resistance when length is near an integer' - and a rate is invisible to a still frame. The promotion demoted the mechanism and built the claim underneath it instead: 'whole numbers resist' is an argument about LEGIBILITY, about which values this apparatus treats as clean
dna.kin: shares one vocabulary with xyz_slider_plate.readout - one word, two apparatuses
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the axis was in the script and the registry had never been told. Its script is NOT a sibling of its scene (scene commons/interface/line.tscn loads res://commons/primitives/line/line.gd), which is why a sibling-path scan missed it
dna.framing_note: gradation and lattice build a graduated row far wider than the bare line, so a hint tuned for numeral crops them. 0.85 holds all four values in frame

lsystem_editor.description: Edit L-system grammars in real-time and watch procedural plants, fractals, and branching structures grow from simple rewriting rules. Adjust axiom, production rules, angle, and iteration depth to explore the space of formal grammars made visible.
lsystem_editor.name: L-System Editor
lsystem_editor.qfep_connection: Rewrite rules are deterministic (F) yet produce organic complexity. The iteration count is like Î» â€” more iterations reveal more detail at the edge of legibility.

magnifying_glass.name: Magnifying Glass
magnifying_glass.qfep_connection: The lens bends no light; the shader rescales SCREEN_UV by 0.7 around center and re-presents pixels already rendered, with a Fresnel rim for a frame. Magnification as honest fake — in a rendered world, 'closer' is only a resampling.

magnifying_glass_red.description: Red variant of magnifying glass for specialized viewing
magnifying_glass_red.name: Magnifying Glass Red
magnifying_glass_red.qfep_connection: The same screen-space lens, except the fragment shader zeroes green and blue on the way out. The filter adds no red — it deletes everything else, which is how most ways of seeing actually operate.

magnifying_glass_tool.description: Advanced magnifying glass tool with additional features
magnifying_glass_tool.name: Magnifying Glass Tool
magnifying_glass_tool.qfep_connection: Three lenses on rigid grabbable handles — two clear, one that keeps only the red channel — laid out for comparison. Instruments arrive in sets so that seeing itself becomes the variable while the thing under the glass stays constant.

mario_cube.description: An interactive surprise cube inspired by classic platformer mechanics — hit it from below to trigger the NextCube signal, remove the DarkSphere, and reveal a rainbow effect. A playful intersection of game design and signal systems.
mario_cube.name: Mario Cube

mario_cube_time_trace.description: Pick-up cube with time-domain trace in +Z, like pendulum trail.
mario_cube_time_trace.name: Mario Cube Time Trace
mario_cube_time_trace.qfep_connection: oscillation: the mario cube leaving a time trace — a familiar body trailing its own signal; every motion is a waveform if you keep the receipts.

matrix_multiply_visual.description: Physical row-times-column dot product. Two matrices float in space.
matrix_multiply_visual.name: Matrix Multiply Visual

memory_display.name: memory_display
memory_display.qfep_connection: A label reading out the process's own static memory in megabytes, refreshed every frame. The world confesses its heap: everything you have walked past is still resident somewhere inside that number.

mondrian_2d.description: A classic Mondrian composition rendered in 2D with geometric precision and De Stijl color palette
mondrian_2d.name: Mondrian 2D Canvas
mondrian_2d.qfep_connection: A 60:55 canvas that redraws its grid of blacks and primaries every ten seconds from random splits. Dynamic equilibrium — Mondrian's word for a balance found once — is recast as a generator's output distribution: F_order as style, E_flux on a timer.

mondrian_3d_display.description: 3D representation of Mondrian compositions with depth and spatial presentation
mondrian_3d_display.name: Mondrian 3D Display

monitorsystem.description: Builds four monitor kiosks with dedicated cameras and viewports for overhead, third-person, mirror, and side views.
monitorsystem.name: monitorsystem
monitorsystem.qfep_connection: Four kiosks, four cameras — overhead, behind, mirror, profile — every viewport locked to you. A panopticon that hands the watched party all of its feeds: surveillance rehearsed as self-portrait, the mirror multiplied into a control room.

monte_carlo_estimator.description: Estimate mathematical quantities through random sampling — watch as dart throws approximate pi, random walks estimate integrals, and stochastic processes converge to deterministic values. The power of randomness as a computational tool.
monte_carlo_estimator.name: Monte Carlo Estimator
monte_carlo_estimator.qfep_connection: Order (Ï€) emerges from randomness through accumulation. Law of large numbers as F-minimization.

nail_color_controller.description: Uses a 3D value mapper to live-adjust VR hand nail materials with a preview cube.
nail_color_controller.name: nail_color_controller
nail_color_controller.qfep_connection: relation: the nails — the chapter's ruled connective heart (L-019, hero by fiat, exempt from every score). A 3D value mapper adjusts the VR hands' own nail material, live, with a preview cube: color applied not to an exhibit but to YOU. Every other room shows color at a distance; here perception paints the perceiver, and the hand that points at the chapter carries the chapter.

non_binary_classifier.description: ML classifier that resists binary convergence.
non_binary_classifier.name: Non-Binary Classifier
non_binary_classifier.qfep_connection: The optimiser is ordinary logistic descent and it is working correctly; what will not hold still is the ground truth, because every sample inside the margin has its label re-drawn before the descent can use it. Set the margin to zero and it converges in seconds — convergence was never a property of the algorithm, it was a claim that everyone had already been sorted.

orbital_mechanics_demo.description: Interactive orbital mechanics simulation — launch satellites, adjust velocity and angle, and watch Kepler's laws emerge from Newton's gravity. Explore circular, elliptical, parabolic, and hyperbolic orbits by tuning initial conditions.
orbital_mechanics_demo.name: Orbital Mechanics Demo
orbital_mechanics_demo.qfep_connection: Orbit as dynamic equilibrium â€” perpetual falling, never landing. Balance between kinetic and potential. Stability from motion.

oscilloscope.description: Multi-mode oscilloscope with VR sliders. Shows waveform, Lissajous patterns, and XY plots. Classic green phosphor CRT aesthetic. Controls: FREQ A/B, Amplitude, Phase, Time/Div.
oscilloscope.name: Oscilloscope

oscilloscope_artifact.description: A virtual oscilloscope displaying real-time waveforms — connect it to audio sources or mathematical functions to visualize signals in the time domain. Adjust timebase, amplitude, and trigger settings like its real-world counterpart.
oscilloscope_artifact.name: Oscilloscope
oscilloscope_artifact.qfep_connection: Five graspable sliders — two frequencies, phase, amplitude, time-per-division — feed a phosphor trace that flips between waveform, Lissajous, and XY. Signal only becomes shape when one oscillation is plotted against another; the instrument stages relation, not tone.

overfitting_demo.name: Overfitting Demo
overfitting_demo.qfep_connection: Two error numbers computed from one fit: the training figure falls to zero as the polynomial gains coefficients, the held-out figure turns and climbs, and the gap between them is the model memorising fifteen accidents of collection. Accuracy measured on the data you fitted is not a measurement, it is a mirror.

perlin_terrain_sculptor.description: Sculpt terrain using Perlin noise parameters — adjust octaves, persistence, lacunarity, and scale to shape landscapes from smooth rolling hills to jagged mountain ranges. Real-time terrain generation making noise mathematics tangible.
perlin_terrain_sculptor.name: Perlin Terrain Sculptor
perlin_terrain_sculptor.qfep_connection: Noise is E(S) made visible. The threshold is a Î»-like parameter â€” where you draw the line between solid and void.

petri_dish_worms.description: Simulated worm-like organisms wriggling in a petri dish — simple steering behaviors and sinusoidal body motion create surprisingly lifelike movement. Emergence of biological-looking behavior from minimal procedural rules.
petri_dish_worms.name: Petri Dish Worms

pick_up_cube.capacity: MOVE an object through space and understand translation as carried displacement.
pick_up_cube.description: A grab-and-carry cube that turns translation into a bodily action. The object does not change shape or orientation much; what matters is that its position is rewritten by the player's movement through space. In puzzle contexts that simple displacement becomes rule-bearing and consequential. It is translation reduced to a portable primitive.
interactions: grab the cube and carry it through the map
drop it onto targets or through gates
change point or value settings through map config
compare object movement against static reference geometry
pick_up_cube.name: Pick Up Cube
pick_up_cube.qfep_connection: Pure S as carried displacement: the cube stays itself while its coordinates change. The artifact isolates translation as the simplest embodied state update.

pickable_showcase.name: pickable_showcase
pickable_showcase.qfep_connection: A census of everything that consents to the hand: cubes, sticks, planes, five Platonic solids, a line, a point, a sheet of paper, each on its own pedestal. Grab is the project's first verb, and here it is conjugated through every geometry at once.

pickup_gate.capacity: REASON about threshold state change: when enough objects move through, the gate transforms from closed to open.
pickup_gate.description: A blocking gate whose state depends on how many pickup cubes have crossed the threshold. Its geometry is simple, but its logic makes transformation legible as a rule: the gate is closed, then open, because enough translated objects changed the count. That turns motion into conditional infrastructure. It teaches that state change can be triggered by accumulated displacement.
interactions: carry pickup cubes into the gate zone
configure how many pickups are required through map tokens
watch the gate open once the threshold is met
use gate color or count settings to stage different collection puzzles
pickup_gate.name: Pickup Gate
pickup_gate.qfep_connection: Transformation here is thresholded state change. Repeated object translations alter the count until the gate preserves a new open identity.

player_position.name: player_position
player_position.qfep_connection: A label that does nothing but say where you are — (x, y, z) to two decimals, refreshed every frame, patiently re-searching the tree until a player exists. The coordinate system's view of you, posted inside your own world: to the grid, a body is three floats.

player_position_to_console.name: player_position_to_console
player_position_to_console.registry_note: Headless console printer — scene root is Node, not Node3D, so it cannot be placed in a map. Kept for direct scene use only.

player_presence_indicator.name: player_presence_indicator
player_presence_indicator.qfep_connection: Presence here is not proximity but scene-graph membership — a label polls five times a second for whether ../../XROrigin3D resolves, and calls that "Player detected". Being seen by this world means being instantiated in its tree.

point_is.name: point_is
point_is.registry_note: RETIRED 2026-07-29 (build-or-retire triage): Registered scene is an empty stub; `point` already carries the coordinate reading.

polyhedron_nets_cube.description: Cube net visualization with fold animation. Configurable via #fold_duration, #fold_delay, #auto_fold.
polyhedron_nets_cube.name: polyhedron_nets_cube
polyhedron_nets_cube.qfep_connection: A cube unfolded flat and folded again before you — the solid revealed as a hinged sheet of six quads. The net is the primitive confessing how it was made: every volume in this world is a surface that agreed to close.

pop_music_demo.description: Interactive generative pop music sequencer with dynamic chord progressions.
pop_music_demo.name: Pop Music Demo
pop_music_demo.qfep_connection: Four chords in a random major key, kick on one and three, hats on the offbeats — the whole song is decompressed from pop's rule-set at load time, every sample synthesized. F_order wearing a genre: intro, verse, and chorus are three densities of the same progression, crossfaded.

portal.description: A vertical portal frame that teleports the player to a destination.
portal.name: Portal
portal.qfep_connection: The frame moves no one; it emits teleporter_activated and lets the sequence system decide what through means. Passage as administration — blue beam when the petition will be honored, red when the door persists but the institution has closed.

pressure_soft_body.description: Inflatable soft body with internal pressure control.
pressure_soft_body.name: Pressure Soft Body
pressure_soft_body.qfep_connection: Pressure is not inflation, it is a disagreement: the solver pushes every vertex out along its normal and the springs pull it back, and the shape you see is where the two settle. Open the mesh anywhere and the argument has no interior to be about, so the body goes limp no matter what the number says.

profiler_flame_graph.description: Interactive flame graph of nested function calls.
profiler_flame_graph.name: Profiler Flame Graph
profiler_flame_graph.qfep_connection: The flame graph refuses to let performance be a scalar: a frame time is one number, but the shape that number has is a topology, and total time tells you which subtree is expensive while only self time tells you which function is. Every optimisation aimed at the widest bar instead of the hottest one was aimed at a container.

queer_morphology_specimen.description: A procedural specimen that defies binary classification — its form shifts between categories, refusing stable taxonomy. A critical theory artifact embodying the QFEP framework's challenge to normative boundaries in biological and computational classification.
queer_morphology_specimen.name: Queer Morphology Specimen
queer_morphology_specimen.qfep_connection: THIS IS QFEP EMBODIED. Î» drives orderâ†’chaos transition in soft body physics. Ï† encodes resistance/embrace of change. At Î»â‰ˆ0.5, specimen breathes at edge of chaos â€” where life emerges. Queer morphology = form as process, not fixed state.

random_space.description: A crystal that contains mathematical chaos algorithms
random_space.name: random_space
random_space.qfep_connection: The floor re-rolls its own heights every tick while collision updates on a slower interval, so what you see and what holds you are briefly two different terrains — chaos rationed to protect the frame rate and the ankles.

random_walk_terrarium.description: A contained ecosystem where random walkers create terrain — trails accumulate into landscapes, paths cross to form structures, and the terrarium slowly fills with the emergent geography of stochastic exploration.
random_walk_terrarium.name: Random Walk Terrarium
random_walk_terrarium.qfep_connection: Random walk as pure E(S) â€” no memory, no direction, maximum entropy. LÃ©vy flights: structured randomness.

reset_area.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
reset_area.name: Cube with shader
reset_area.qfep_connection: A kilometre-wide catch-plane hiding beneath the map, zeroing your velocity twice before setting you back at spawn — and manufacturing a spawn point if none exists. Falling out of the world is quietly made impossible; the floor under the floor is the promise that no failure here is terminal.

reset_cube.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
reset_cube.name: Cube with shader
reset_cube.qfep_connection: The same catch-and-return logic as the hidden safety floor, shrunk to a pink shader-lit cylinder you must walk into. Reset recoded from net to door: going home becomes something the body chooses.

rhizome_navigator.description: Deleuze and Guattari rhizome as navigable graph.
rhizome_navigator.name: Rhizome Navigator
rhizome_navigator.qfep_connection: Every graph drawn on a table has a front, and a front is a beginning. Laid flat under the feet with twelve legal entrances, identical plinths, a hole where the trunk would stand, and a pulse that arrives from a different direction every few seconds, the rhizome stops being a picture of non-hierarchy and becomes a floor that cannot tell you where you started.

schlegel_diagram.name: Schlegel Diagram
schlegel_diagram.qfep_connection: Eight congruent cells, and the one nearest the observer gets to be the container -- the nesting a Schlegel diagram shows is a fact about the camera, not the polytope. It is perspective caught doing what perspective always does: converting proximity into hierarchy and then presenting the result as structure.

sequencer.description: Music and audio sequencer for algorithmic composition
sequencer.name: Sequencer
sequencer.qfep_connection: Named for music, it makes none — six light patterns (running dot, checkerboard, diagonal sweep) chase across a tile grid forever, timing rendered as pure albedo. The score without the sound: sequence itself, stripped to visible order.

settings_ui.name: settings_ui
settings_ui.qfep_connection: A dropdown where the curriculum's whole law of progression sits one enum from abolition — select Explorer and every sequence unlocks. The lock system admits, in a settings panel, that it was always a choice.

sine_wave_controller.description: Pair of value mappers that expose sine-wave frequency, amplitude, and phase and optionally drive the Mario slider rig.
sine_wave_controller.name: sine_wave_controller
sine_wave_controller.qfep_connection: A sine has exactly three degrees of freedom, and each gets a graspable body: a 2D pad for frequency and amplitude, a 1D slider for phase. The equation is never displayed; you learn its shape by holding its parameters.

soft_body_slicer.description: Cut soft bodies with a laser plane.
soft_body_slicer.name: Soft Body Slicer
soft_body_slicer.qfep_connection: A mesh boolean asks where the surface goes; a soft body has no surface, it has a graph, and the surface is a picture drawn of the graph afterwards. Cut the graph and the picture follows — cut the picture and nothing happens at all.

sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.description: Procedural wall drawings from text instructions.
sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.name: Sol LeWitt Wall Drawing
sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.qfep_connection: LeWitt sold the sentence, not the wall, so this artifact refuses to show one without the other: the rule is legible text at reading height and the execution is dense geometry beside it, and the seed proves the gap between them is real rather than rhetorical. Authorship here is a boundary that will not hold — the instruction is the work, the drafting is the work, and neither can be demoted to a copy of the other.

sparse_array_demo.description: Visualizes sparse vs dense 2D array storage. Toggle between full grid and sparse representation.
sparse_array_demo.name: Sparse Array Demo
sparse_array_demo.qfep_connection: Sparse arrays encode absence as information.

speed_display.name: speed_display
speed_display.qfep_connection: A label printing Engine.time_scale every frame — the one parameter the player lives inside, gauged. When the engine slows the world, everything slows in sympathy; this readout is the only witness that "1.00x" was ever anything but natural.

spit_text_3d.name: spit_text_3d
spit_text_3d.qfep_connection: Text arrives at typing speed, letter by letter, line by line, toggled from the A-button; dismissed, its labels are not hidden but freed. Reading restaged as duration, un-reading as deletion.

spring_chain.description: Chain of masses connected by springs. Drag one end and watch the wave propagate.
spring_chain.name: Spring Chain
spring_chain.qfep_connection: Spring chains are the discrete skeleton of wave equations.

spring_demo.description: A hands-on spring physics demonstration — stretch, compress, and release springs to feel Hooke's law in action. Visualizes the relationship between displacement, restoring force, and oscillation with real-time force vectors.
spring_demo.name: Spring Demo

spring_network.description: Mass-spring lattice — a 6x6 grid of masses connected by springs that deform and oscillate. Verlet integration for stability, strain-colored spring lines, and fixed corner anchors. Extends Hooke's law from single springs to 2D networks.
spring_network.name: Spring Network

standalone_disco.description: Self-contained disco floor with white tiles and pattern control. Config: width:8, depth:8, tile_size:0.5, show_controls:true
standalone_disco.name: Standalone Disco Floor
standalone_disco.qfep_connection: The array as dancefloor — a grid of tiles lighting in programmed patterns, the 2D array turned nightclub. Proof that the humblest data structure, a grid of cells each holding a state, is enough to choreograph a room. Indices become tiles, values become light.

surveillance_panopticon.description: Foucault panopticon. Central tower with CCTV cones.
surveillance_panopticon.name: Surveillance Panopticon
surveillance_panopticon.qfep_connection: Every tower surface is opaque and its one lit surface is a sealed band, while ten translucent cones make the watching legible from the cells and from nowhere else — visibility is built as a one-way material property, so the asymmetry needs no caption to survive. The sweep steps between cones without announcing itself: you can always read who is lit, never who is looking, and the tower works exactly as well with nobody inside it.

tesla_sparks.description: Tesla coil spark effects for electrical visualization
tesla_sparks.name: Tesla Sparks
tesla_sparks.qfep_connection: Every frame a fresh jagged path is rebuilt between two grabbable spheres — endpoints fixed by hands, every intermediate vertex jittered anew. E_flux on a leash: the randomness never escapes the segment your grip defines.

tesla_sphere.description: Tesla sphere for electrical field interaction
tesla_sphere.name: Tesla Sphere
tesla_sphere.qfep_connection: A glowing pickable with gravity_scale −0.1, drifting faintly upward until held; its grab handler either emits a signal or files progress with a TaskManagerController. Touch is scored — the moment of grasp is where play gets audited.

text_display.name: text_display
text_display.qfep_connection: A violet glass pane carrying a 2D page inside a Viewport2Din3D, ringed by a hand-pose area that bends any approaching hand into a point. The scene decides how the body reads before a word appears: pages here demand a finger.

transform_matrix_cube.description: Interactive 3D cube with its transformation matrix displayed in real-time. Rotate, scale, and translate the cube while watching the 4x4 matrix update — making the abstract algebra of linear transformations concrete and visual.
transform_matrix_cube.name: Transform Matrix Cube
transform_matrix_cube.qfep_connection: Matrix as transformation rule â€” how one space maps to another. det(M) shows information preservation/loss.

tts_test.name: TTS Test
tts_test.qfep_connection: One hard-coded sentence spoken aloud, then an audit that "tts" exists in the UtilityRegistry, reported to the console as check or cross. Speech in this world is a grid utility — a voice must be registered before it can be heard.

turing_pattern_generator.description: Generate reaction-diffusion Turing patterns in real-time — spots, stripes, and labyrinthine structures emerge from the interplay of activator and inhibitor chemicals diffusing at different rates. Alan Turing's morphogenesis made visible.
turing_pattern_generator.name: Turing Pattern Generator
turing_pattern_generator.qfep_connection: Turing patterns emerge at specific feed/kill ratios â€” another Î» parameter space. Order (uniform) vs chaos (noise) with patterns at the edge.

value_mapper_example.description: Demonstrates 1D, 2D, and 3D value mappers driving sphere scale, position, color, and audio hooks.
value_mapper_example.name: value_mapper_example
value_mapper_example.qfep_connection: One sphere absorbs three mappings at once: a 1D value becomes its size, 2D its position, 3D its emissive color. The mapping is the whole ontology; the sphere is merely the surface where dimensionality lands.

vera_molnar_des_ordres.description: Grid of squares with controlled randomness. Disorder slider.
vera_molnar_des_ordres.name: Vera Molnar Des-Ordres
vera_molnar_des_ordres.qfep_connection: Order and disorder are not two states here but one continuous setting, and because the per-cell deviation is positional rather than resampled, the viewer watches a single composition lose its grip instead of watching new compositions flicker past. The interesting region is not marked on the rail — you have to find by hand the degree at which a square stops being square, which is a boundary nobody can specify in advance.

viscous_fluid_blob.name: Viscous Fluid Blob
viscous_fluid_blob.qfep_connection: Two presses to the same depth, one over four seconds and one over fifteen hundredths, and only the slow one gets in — the strain rate is fed straight back into the constraint stiffness, so the material's category is decided by the timing of the question rather than by anything in the substance. Shear thickening read as a threshold: solid for exactly as long as you are quick, and fluid the moment you are patient.

voronoi_space.description: A crystal that contains territorial boundary algorithms
voronoi_space.name: voronoi_space
voronoi_space.qfep_connection: Twenty random seeds, and every point of the floor swears allegiance to the nearest one, inheriting its height — so borders arrive underfoot as sudden steps. Territory as adjacency, not essence: move one seed and whole provinces change altitude.

wave_equation_solver.description: 2D wave equation on a membrane — finite difference PDE solver simulating a struck drumhead. Gaussian pulse propagates and reflects off clamped boundaries with viscous damping. ImmediateMesh surface colored by displacement: blue positive, red negative, dark zero.
wave_equation_solver.name: Wave Equation Solver
wave_equation_solver.qfep_connection: u_tt = c²∇²u on a clamped membrane: the fixed boundary is the whole reason a ripple becomes a note rather than a spill, and the viscous damping is E_flux leaking away frame by frame. The Courant number is a treaty — let space-step and time-step disagree past 1/√2 and the drumhead detonates instead of sings.

wave_interference_tank.description: A ripple tank simulation showing wave interference patterns — place point sources and watch circular waves superpose, creating constructive and destructive interference. The physical demonstration that reveals the wave nature of light, sound, and quantum mechanics.
wave_interference_tank.name: Wave Interference Tank
wave_interference_tank.qfep_connection: Superposition â€” waves don't fight, they add. Patterns emerge from phase relationships. Information through interference.

dna.default: evidence=result - the shipped code path, so existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: ten exports and every one a dial on the physics — frequency, amplitude, speed, separation, phase, tank size, three colours — and not one about the demonstration. The two component waves exist in _update_wave_surface() for one line each before being added together and thrown away: computed 4096 times a frame and never shown once
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 — the axis was already in the script and the registry had never been told, so the sweep could not reach it

xyz_coordinates.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
xyz_coordinates.name: XYZ coordinates
xyz_coordinates.qfep_connection: The addressing scheme laid bare — x, y, z, the three numbers that turn empty space into an array of positions. Before any value can be stored somewhere, somewhere has to be nameable; this is the chapter's quiet foundation, the Cartesian grid that makes 'the cell at (3,1,4)' a sentence with a referent.

zelda_tilemap.description: Zelda-style tilemap system for game-like environments
zelda_tilemap.name: Zelda Tilemap
zelda_tilemap.qfep_connection: F_order: a landscape flattened into a lookup table, sixty-by-sixty cells each resolving through a seven-key dictionary into one of seven colors and seven heights. Terrain here is not felt but indexed — a mountain is only the row that maps to 0.5.

zelda_tilemap_2d.description: 2D Zelda-style tilemap for retro game aesthetics
zelda_tilemap_2d.name: Zelda Tilemap 2D
zelda_tilemap_2d.qfep_connection: The same seven-terrain dictionary before it is granted relief — elevation collapsed back to pure color on a plane. What the 3D version stages as height, this holds as flat legend, the map admitting it was always a table of names.

zelda_tiles_3d.description: 3D Zelda-style tiles for dimensional game environments
zelda_tiles_3d.name: Zelda Tiles 3D
zelda_tiles_3d.qfep_connection: The world rendered into a SubViewport and mounted on the face of a grabbable RigidBody — the terrain you would have walked becomes a thing you pick up and turn. Cartography's oldest sleight, the territory shrunk to a handheld object, made literal and physical.

artifact_workstation.description: VR Artifact Workstation — browse and test any of 1692 artifacts from inside VR. Navigate by sequence, type, or all. Arrow keys for desktop, VR buttons for headset.
artifact_workstation.name: Artifact Workstation
artifact_workstation.qfep_connection: A museum where every exhibit is live code: any of 1692 lookup names instantiates at your feet, stripped of the map that gave it meaning. Useful, and quietly violent — the catalogue view is exactly what forty sequences of curriculum were built to refuse.

demo_singles.name: demo_singles
demo_singles.qfep_connection: Eight verbs of the hand — press, twist, slide, throw, spin, tilt, point — pinned to a panel as copper geometry that answers nothing. A type specimen of agency: the interaction vocabulary is shown to be finite and inherited, fixed before any parameter arrives to be controlled.

demo_passive.name: demo_passive
demo_passive.qfep_connection: Speakers with no signal, VU meters holding no level, monitors with no feed — the answering half of the rack, shown mute. It stages how much of 'apparatus' is just the shape of expected output: grilles and needles promise a response the way a chair promises sitting, before any circuit exists to keep the promise.

demo_compounds.name: demo_compounds
demo_compounds.qfep_connection: Nothing here is new — every compound is the same slider and meter repeated at 0.03-metre intervals — yet 'mixer', 'console', 'monitoring rig' appear anyway. The higher-order instrument lives entirely in spacing: adjacency is the only ingredient, which makes the panel an argument that composition is a place, not a part.

tt.name: Tutorial Text Display
tt.description: In-world tutorial text panel using codeDisplay scene. Format: tt:tutorial_name[:rotation[:y_offset[:scale]]]. Loads text from tutorial_text_library by key. Used across all sequences for contextual learning text.
tt.notes: Token processed by GridUtilitiesComponent._parse_tutorial_display_utility(). Can appear in interactables layer with tt: prefix followed by tutorial key.
tt.qfep_connection: The plate that speaks — in-world tutorial text as a framed 2D-in-3D board rather than a floating label. The project's chosen way for a room to say something and stay a room: text seated in the world on a surface, the humble carrier of nearly every explanation the curriculum offers.

3t.name: 3D Text Display
3t.description: In-world 3D text display using TextMesh. Format: 3t:Message_Text (underscores become spaces). Used for short contextual labels in map scenes.

request_note.name: Request Note
request_note.description: Annotation apparatus placed in maps. DNA: mode selects the note's BODY (float=legacy billboard text, plate=card, stake=card on a post that meets the floor, decal=laid flat, read looking down); tone selects the register (request/bug/question/done) and drives the accent stripe and glyph. Use #text:message or #key:name, plus #mode: and #tone:.

dna.default: mode=float - the pre-promotion behaviour, so all 716 existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: zero exports and no body: a Label3D billboarding in mid-air, on the most-placed artifact in the project

request_note.qfep_connection: A todo that lives at the coordinates it complains about: the note floats where the fix belongs, so the map carries its own unfinishedness as furniture rather than hiding it in a tracker.

dna_workstation.name: DNA Workstation
dna_workstation.description: VR browser for all DNA substrate variants. Kiosk panel with substrate + config picker; live-renders L-system, Trajectory, Pattern, RD, Primitive-stack variants in the presentation area. Same pattern as ArtifactWorkstationVR but for the DNA research corpus.
dna_workstation.qfep_connection: Genotype picker at the kiosk, phenotype grown live at origin — L-system, trajectory, pattern, reaction-diffusion, each substrate rebuilt on selection. The vr_preview caps admit the politics of rendering: the same DNA expresses differently depending on who is watching and how much compute they are owed.

transform_composition_workbench.name: Transform Composition Workbench
transform_composition_workbench.description: Interactive 3D workbench. A slider selects one of 4 transformation pairs; the same base tetrahedron is shown after T1∘T2 (left) and T2∘T1 (right). Order matters — except for pair 2 (rotation × uniform scale around origin) which commutes. Paired with /transform-composition-gallery.

hand_scanner.name: Hand Scanner
hand_scanner.description: Palm-reader pad — hover an open hand over the glowing plate; a scan line sweeps, a dwell ring fills, and on completion it flashes ACCEPTED with chime + haptic. The proximity/dwell hand modality: recognition by presence, not contact. Signals: scan_started, scan_progress(0..1), scan_complete, scan_aborted. Desktop pointer click runs an instant scan.

grab_cube.name: Grab Cube
grab_cube.description: A small free cube you grab and carry with full 6-DOF — the grab-carry hand modality. Glows on highlight, hums when held. Extends XRToolsPickable. Signals: grabbed, dropped.
grab_cube.qfep_connection: Six degrees of freedom granted and then quietly curated: carry it anywhere, but release near a shelf_snap_point and it is pulled onto the grid of sanctioned resting places. The freedom of holding was real; the freedom of putting down was pre-negotiated.

snap_socket.name: Snap Socket
snap_socket.description: A lit cradle that magnetically seats a matching token when a hand brings it close — the snap/place modality. Wraps XRToolsSnapZone; spawns a matching token pre-seated. Green when filled, amber when empty. Signals: socket_filled, socket_emptied.

poke_keypad.name: Poke Keypad
poke_keypad.description: A 3x3 grid of small keys pressed with a single fingertip — the precise finger-poke modality, distinct from the palm-push button. Each key depresses + lights on poke. Optional unlock_code sequence. Signals: key_pressed(index), code_entered.

climb_grip.name: Climb Grip
climb_grip.description: A chunky rung you grab to pull your own body past — the climb modality, the only hand verb that moves the SELF not the object. Wraps XRToolsClimbable; needs the player movement-climb function to feel its effect.

gadget_wall.name: Gadget Wall
gadget_wall.description: A teaching wall of every hand interaction — press, hover/dwell, poke, grab-carry, snap, climb, lever, sliders, dial, wheel, joystick, XY pad — one of each, labelled, each with a status dot that lights when used. Successor to InteractableDemo, sampling MODALITIES.

registry_info.description: Standalone museum-style artifacts living in commons/artifacts/ — interactive 3D exhibits covering waves, physics, math, biology, fractals, cellular automata, and more.
registry_info.name: commons_artifacts
